THE PRINTED COLUMN HEADER, READ OFF THE PAGE AND WRITTEN DOWN (rule 13b.4), is `COLLECTION OF TAXES` | `FORWARD` | `COMMITTMENTS` | `ADJUSTMENTS` | `REFUNDS` | `PAYMENTS` | `ABATEMENTS` | `TRANSFER` | `BALANCES` -- `COMMITTMENTS` is the page's own spelling and is kept. SIGNS ARE THE PAGE'S, NOT OURS: payments, abatements and most transfers print in parentheses and are stored negative; a few transfers and adjustments print positive and are stored positive.
